extensionDescription.message: Enlarge images on hover for better accessibility. Perfect for visually impaired users.

descriptionMain.message: Hover over an image or link to an image to enlarge it instantly.

descEnableExtension.message: Turn the image magnifier on or off.

descZoomOptions.message: Choose how enlarged images are displayed.

descRadioNatural.message: Show the enlarged image next to the original.

descRadioPage.message: Overlay the enlarged image over the page.

optionsWelcomeThanks.message: Thank you for installing Hover Zoom!

optionsWelcomeDefaultSettings.message: The extension has been configured with default settings:

optionsWelcomeStep1.message: Grant permissions below so the extension works on all sites

optionsWelcomeStep2.message: Simply hover over an image on any web page

optionsWelcomeStep3.message: Press Escape to close the zoom

optionsPermissionsWhyDescription.message: Hover Zoom needs to access web pages to detect images and display previews. Without this permission, the extension can only work on the current active page.

optionsReinjectDescription.message: Use this button if the extension doesn't work on already open tabs.

optionsInfoActivationStep2.message: Reload pages where the extension doesn't work

optionsInfoActivationStep3.message: Use the "Reactivate on all open tabs" button
